name: Jerry Can
text: Holds 20 L of one fuel. Use on a tank to pour in, sneak-use to draw out, right-click a vehicle to refuel it. Age V.

name: Tracked Chassis
text: A 12 tonne light tank hull on two tracks, 36 km/h top speed, 300 kW diesel from its own 600 L tank. Sit in it: W and S drive, A and D steer, and standing still it pivots on the spot. Climbs a full block. Age VI.
